headline: Bolsonaro Drops Brazil Election Challenge as Party Concedes Defeat
summary: Jair Bolsonaro backed away from contesting the presidential election as his party conceded defeat, saying 'the system won' following Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's runoff victory with 51.79% of the vote.
why: Brazil is Latin America's largest economy; the concession of election results diminishes political risk and averts institutional disruption for sovereign and corporate assets.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: The concession prevents political paralysis and reduces the country risk premium on Brazilian assets.

why_moved: Bolsonaro's party conceded the election and abandoned legal challenges, removing immediate fears of prolonged constitutional instability.
